subject.text: URGENT: Your account will be blocked in 1 hour

body.text: We detected suspicious activity on your account. Click the link below to verify:
If you do not verify, your account will be blocked permanently.

explanation: The sender's domain is not banknusantara.test, and the real address of the link goes to akun-aman.test. A bank never asks you to verify your account through an email link.
hints: Don't trust the sender's name. Look at the full email address.
Press and hold or right-click the link. Where does it really go, and who owns that domain?
